title: Package Script CWD Fix
requirements: Add `cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"` immediately after PROJECT_ROOT is computed and before invoking xcodebuild; fail fast (set -e or explicit test) with a clear message if the directory is unreachable
acceptance_criteria: Invoking the script from another directory (e.g. `cd /tmp && /path/to/scripts/package.sh`) succeeds and produces a signed .app
xcodebuild logs show the project root as the working directory
Script exits non-zero with a clear message if the project root cannot be reached
